<script lang="ts">
	// A line comment between a mapped type's key name and its `in` keyword stays
	// after the name; the `in T` tail continues one indent level in.

		[
			K in T // c
		]: V;

	// The `as` clause's before-keyword gap takes the same continuation.

			K in T as U // c
		]: V;

		]: V;
